title: Add M1 plate tectonics simulation
description:
## M1 — Tectonics (plate dynamics, boundary classification, hotspot tracks, 500 Myr sim)

Per .design/realistic-planet-generator.md §"Build milestones" M1 and design.md §5 Stage 1. Builds on M0 (commit 01daaca) which provided WebGPU scaffolding, mesh generator (level 8 default), mesh-type abstraction, and worker boundary.

### In scope

1. **Plate initialization (`src/sim/tectonics/plates.ts`).**
   - Distribute P plate centers as a Poisson-disk sample on the sphere (P typically 8-15, default 12 from Layer 1 params per design.md §6.1).
   - Build initial plates via spherical Voronoi tessellation around centers (use `d3-geo-voronoi`).
   - Assign continental vs oceanic per-plate using `continental_fraction` Layer 1 parameter (default 0.3).
   - Generate Euler poles by sampling random axes; rotation rates from a distribution centered on `mean_plate_velocity` parameter (default 5 cm/yr) with realistic spread (most plates 1-10 cm/yr, a few outliers).
   - Output: `plates: array<Plate>` (length P) with `eulerPole : vec3<f32>`, `rotationRate : f32`, `isContinental : u32`, `area : f32`, `centroid : vec3<f32>`.

2. **Tectonic state buffers** (per design.md §4.2):
   - `plateID : array<u32>` length N
   - `crustType : array<u32>` length N (0=oceanic, 1=continental)
   - `crustAge : array<f32>` length N (Myr)
   - `crustThickness : array<f32>` length N (km)
   - `elevation : array<f32>` length N (m relative to sea level — alias `elevationBedrock` for M2 erosion)
   - `upliftRate : array<f32>` length N (m/Myr)

3. **`src/shaders/tectonic_step.wgsl`** kernel implementing per-cell tectonic step (per design.md §5 Stage 1 sketch):
   - Per cell, compute `v_self = cross(omega_p, pos_i)` for own plate; for each neighbor in a different plate, compute `v_other` and `convergence = -dot(v_self − v_other, normal)`.
   - Track `maxConvergence`, `maxDivergence`, `convergentNeighborPlate`.
   - **Boundary classification** when threshold exceeded:
     - Convergent oceanic-continental: subduction. Oceanic side becomes trench (deep). Continental cell ~100 km inland on overriding plate becomes volcanic arc with uplift.
     - Convergent continental-continental: collision. Both cells uplift; crust thickens (Himalayan-style).
     - Convergent oceanic-oceanic: island arc. Older (denser) plate subducts; volcanic islands on overriding.
     - Divergent: spreading. New oceanic crust at boundary. Continental divergence = rift; sustained rifting eventually produces new ocean.
     - Transform: strike-slip, no vertical motion but track lateral offset.
   - **Square-root-of-age oceanic subsidence** (Parsons & Sclater 1977): `elevationBedrock = -2500.0 + (-350.0 * sqrt(crustAge))`.
   - Continental crust never subducts (REQ-4 invariant).

4. **Hotspots (`src/sim/tectonics/hotspots.ts`).**
   - Stored as fixed mantle-frame positions with activation time.
   - Each step, find the cell currently above each active hotspot. That cell receives volcanic uplift and joins the hotspot's track.
   - Track = sequence of cells the hotspot has been under, with associated ages — moving away from hotspot, ages increase (REQ-4 invariant: hotspot tracks aligned with plate motion direction within 15°).
   - Painted hotspot constraints (Layer 2) NOT in this milestone — just default random hotspots.

5. **CPU-side split/merge events (`src/sim/tectonics/topology.ts`).** Per REQ-15.
   - Plate split: sustained extensional stress (computed during tectonic step) exceeds threshold along a connected curve through a continental plate.
   - Plate merge: two plates in continuous collision for more than ~50 Myr with no relative motion.
   - Thresholds tuned to produce **3-5 topology events per 500 Myr default sim** across 100 random seeds (mean 4, σ ≤ 1) per AC-15.
   - Implementation: brief readback of plateID + stress fields → CPU-side connected-component analysis along stress curves → mutate plates buffer + plateID buffer → upload back. Must complete within one frame (≤ 16.7ms) at level 8 per AC-15.
   - "Freeze plate topology" toggle in Layer 1 disables both events.

6. **Pipeline integration (`src/sim/pipeline.ts`, `src/sim/worker.ts`).**
   - Worker exposes `runTectonics(durationMyr: number, dt: number, seed: number): Promise<void>`.
   - Default 500 Myr with appropriate `dt` (say 1 Myr per step → 500 dispatches).
   - Emits progress events at ~1 Hz.
   - Final tectonic state snapshot consumable by future M2 erosion stage.

7. **Globe rendering update.** Add layer toggle for plate-ID coloring (one color per plate, max ~16 colors with hashing) and elevation coloring (heightmap colormap: oceanic blue → coastal green → mountain brown → snow white). Frag-shader path in `src/shaders/globe_fragment.wgsl` should accept either visual layer.

8. **Invariant test suite.** Run at end of every full tectonic sim (CI-runnable):
   - `|Σ divergence_rate − Σ convergence_rate| / max(...) < 1e-3` (AC-4 partial — full divergence-convergence balance).
   - Crust age monotone non-decreasing along flow lines from spreading center to subduction zone (AC-4 partial — full check requires hydrology, but tectonic-only check: per plate, age increases with distance from spreading boundary).
   - Hotspot track angle vs plate motion direction within 15° at every track cell (AC-4 partial).
   - Continental crust never subducts (REQ-4 invariant).
   - 100-seed Monte Carlo confirms 3-5 topology events per 500 Myr (mean 4, σ ≤ 1) (AC-15).

### Out of scope (do not start)
- M2 erosion (`erosion_step.wgsl`, hillslope diffusion, stream power)
- M3 hydrology (flow direction, accumulation, pit fill, river extraction)
- M4/M9 climate (GCM, temperature, precipitation, biomes)
- M7 regional refinement
- M8/M10 civilization layer
- Layer 2 painted constraints (M6) — agent should design with constraint hooks in mind but not implement painting UI
- Persistence beyond what M0 provided
- Exports

### Acceptance criteria for M1
- [ ] All four boundary classification cases produce correct uplift / subsidence / age behavior in unit tests with synthetic plate configurations.
- [ ] Divergence-convergence balance holds: |Σ div − Σ conv| / max < 1e-3 across 10 random-seed 500 Myr sims.
- [ ] Crust age monotone test passes: for each plate, age along plate-motion vector increases (within numerical tolerance for cell discretization).
- [ ] Hotspot track angle test: every track cell's track-vector vs its plate's motion-vector within 15°.
- [ ] Continental crust never subducts: post-sim check `crustType` of any cell that was continental at start remains continental (no "lost" cells).
- [ ] 100-seed Monte Carlo: split+merge event count per 500 Myr sim has mean 4, σ ≤ 1.
- [ ] CPU-side plate split/merge mutation completes within 16.7ms at level 8 (microbenchmark).
- [ ] "Freeze plate topology" toggle disables splits and merges in Layer 1 store.
- [ ] Globe renders plate-ID and elevation layers cleanly at level 8 default; layer toggle UI works (can be a simple button row, full Layer 1 sliders are M5).
- [ ] `pnpm tsc --noEmit` + tests pass.
- [ ] No stubs / TODOs / "implement later" placeholders. Constraint hooks for Layer 2 (M6) can be commented type signatures only — actual painting UI is M6.

### References
- .design/realistic-planet-generator.md REQ-4, REQ-6, REQ-15, AC-4, AC-15
- .design/realistic-planet-generator.plan.json gaps B6 (16.7ms budget tight), C3 (flow accumulation GPU note — M3 concern)
- design.md §5 Stage 1 (kernel sketch, boundary types, invariants)
- design.md §4.3 (CPU topology events rationale)
